critical_code_review_comments: fx/live.py resolve_symbol sort key: suffix preference uses `_norm(n)[len(symbol)-1:]`; for alias roots shorter than the symbol (GOLDb → 'GOLDB'[5:] == '') the suffix is never detected, so alias candidates are only ordered by length (e.g. ['GOLD','GOLDb','GOLDc','GOLDr','GOLDx','XAUUSD'] for suffix b). Works today thanks to the tradeMode FULL filter, but with >6 candidates (cands[:6]) the tradable one could be cut off. Suggest computing the tail relative to the matched alias length (len(alias)) instead of len(symbol)-1.
Optional: our_symbol() is O(n) over symbol_map per position; fine for 12 pairs.
